title: GET /api/v1/receipts/export (one JSONL line)
description: The receipts module's verifier-food export: application/x-ndjson, one signed receipt per line in chain order from ?since_seq, exactly tools/verifier's ExportRow. payload is the canonical text that was signed (a checkpoint's carries checkpoint_seq, merkle_root, leaf_count, device_key_id, issued_at); receipt_hash_hex of the newest line is the local chain view's head.hash. Witness heads are GET /api/v1/receipts/witness, not a per-line field.
